top3.headline: Gemini 4 Neon topped Monday's Perplexity usage by 23.5% before Tuesday ended
top3.whyItMatters: Model preference can flip in days; keep your stack able to switch models quickly.

top3.headline: Ruben Hassid shares his full daily Claude Skills library for free
top3.whyItMatters: Packaged routines save rebuilding setup each chat; collect your team's best ones.

top3.headline: Simon Willison argues LLMs hit three inflection points in twelve months
top3.whyItMatters: If the tools changed three times this year, last year's AI plan likely needs a review.

items.title: Matt Pocock opens a 2,000-commit repo on how code should be structured
items.takeaway: Pocock shares an unfinished repo showing his current thinking on code structure.
items.soWhat: Teams setting coding standards for agents can study a working reference before writing their own.

items.title: Meng To shares a 22-minute image-to-design tutorial for landing pages
items.takeaway: Meng To says starting from an image avoids AI slop, and walks through his landing page process in Linen.
items.soWhat: Starting from an image, not a prompt, is one way design teams avoid generic AI output.

items.title: Ruben Hassid gives away the Claude Skills library he uses daily
items.takeaway: Hassid shares his daily Claude Skills for free; a Skill is a /command that fires itself.
items.soWhat: Skills turn repeated setup into one command; ask teams which routines deserve one.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon hit 44.52B Perplexity tokens Tuesday, beating Monday early
items.takeaway: Tuesday's 44.52B tokens were 23.5% above Monday's 36.06B with more than 3 hours left.
items.soWhat: Usage is shifting fast toward Gemini 4 Neon; check whether your model choices still fit.

items.title: Steinberger says open-source OC found prosumer and enterprise adoption
items.takeaway: Steinberger calls OC's multiplayer team feature best in class and says reliable free open source is hard.
items.soWhat: Open-source tools now win enterprise users; ask who keeps them reliable before you depend on one.

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen builds a 3D globe that turns lightning into music
items.takeaway: DeepMind shows a Gemini 4 Hydrogen demo mapping live lightning strikes to ambient music.
items.soWhat: Labs market models by what they build in one go; judge them on your own tasks.

items.title: Simon Willison names three LLM inflection points from the past year
items.takeaway: Willison expands his AI Engineer talk into a written argument about three LLM inflection points.
items.soWhat: A practitioner's year review is a quick check on whether your AI plans match what changed.

items.title: Anthropic Fellows revisit single neurons as a way to read models
items.takeaway: New Fellows research returns to neurons as the unit for understanding what happens inside a model.
items.soWhat: Better tools for seeing inside models make AI safety claims easier to check.

image.alt: @AnthropicAI on X: Anthropic Fellows revisit single neurons as a way to read models

items.title: Amjad Masad: America can lead models and still lose the AI race
items.takeaway: Masad says Jensen Huang's return matters because governments want sovereign AI on their own infrastructure.
items.soWhat: Governments want AI on their own soil; that shapes where vendors build and who wins deals.

voices.quote: I really haven’t seen this fast day-over-day growth rate for a model inside Perplexity in a while.
America can build the best frontier models and still lose the global AI race.
Understanding what’s happening inside an AI model helps to make it safer.
The image-to-design workflow is pretty much a cheat code for avoiding ai slops.
Shipping reliable and free open source is also really really hard

hotOnX.note: People want to know if looking at single neurons can finally explain model behavior.

hotOnX.text: Theo says he sees a coordinated effort to attack T3 Code's reputation.
hotOnX.note: Open-source coding tool rivalry and telemetry trust are drawing a crowd.

hotOnX.text: When an AI agent can escape its sandbox, will it choose to?
hotOnX.note: Agent safety in weak sandboxes is a live worry for anyone deploying agents.

hotOnX.text: A guide to handing pull request follow-up work to Claude Ship and staying in flow.
hotOnX.note: Builders want agents to own the review loop after a PR opens.

hotOnX.note: A fast usage jump hints at where builders are moving their model spend.
